definitions.primary_unit: one cited claim--abstract pair; selected claim and document IDs are both unique
definitions.reference: source SUPPORT/CONTRADICT evidence entry; derived NOINFO only for a cited doc without evidence entry
definitions.correctness: valid prediction matches the reference; invalid/error is not correct
definitions.robust_correct: reference-correct in both base and reversed-option-order
definitions.flip: unequal selected labels among pairs valid in both compared conditions
definitions.excess_flip: mean of reversal/title flip minus exact-repeat flip on triple-valid cases
definitions.interval: 10,000 paired, label-stratified claim/document-cluster percentile bootstrap draws; pointwise descriptive 95% intervals
definitions.sampling: fixed model-blind balanced 60/60/60 selection; intervals do not estimate natural SciFact prevalence
